learning.example:
A: The request takes several seconds. What feedback should we show while it is loading?
B: Show a spinner so people know the page is still working.
A: Can we report progress without promising an exact finish time?
B: Yes. Keep the spinner visible until the result appears.
learning.exampleChinese:
A: 这个请求需要几秒钟。加载时应该展示什么反馈？

A: 我们能否报告进度，但不承诺精确完成时间？
B: 可以。结果出现前一直显示加载转圈。
